model: Frozen original 101-only Aug. Predict original seven head logits, NOT weights or old flux differences.
operators: Original CPU-float32 initialized physical FFT buffers converted unchanged to double, rectangular P33, zero mean, native RK4; no repeated Gaussian filtering
startup: ONE shared native Aug RK4 step t=1..1.005 per case/seed, then two fresh branch anchors at its w0,w1. All four methods share these states and startup history. Fresh-C4 begins stage-wise symmetrization at t=1.005; the first .005 is COMMON_AUG_STARTUP, explicitly excluded from method-specific timing. Full t=1..5 state tables retain that common interval.

refresh.policy: First refresh pending; only promote a COMPLETE pair. Initial pair0,1 is shared. Each method refreshes from its OWN autonomous state.
refresh.hold: Use last head of last COMPLETE pair
refresh.stage_history: Never change anchors within a native RK4 step. Four orientations remain separate raw coordinates.

flux: For each orientation j decode original FULL on CURRENT R_j w with predicted H_j, inverse-rotate actual qd/qb and mean. No historical flux addition, no new limiter or neural branch.
physical_policy: STRICT_STOP for each trajectory at first nonfinite/numerical safety/physical envelope violation. Save full failed stage, masks, ratios, anchors, source and receipt. Continue OTHER independent trajectories. Never integrate past an inadmissible stage; no permissive diagnostic continuation.
envelope: Exact closed Leith/c/SPD trace2 condition<=16 feasibility certificate plus CURRENT C4 composite signed amplitude and transfer bounds; closed envelope PASS does NOT prove original bounded heads or shared frozen CNN reachability
adapter_tolerance_source: original frozen protocol reference_adapter_relative_tolerance=5e-5; use for native buffer velocity-vs-inverse K and advection leakage only, never relax physical envelope
tail_policy: Record high>=30 and corner(actual radius>33 within P33) separately and their changes. No invented monotone-tail or positive-transfer instability threshold. Only inherited total K/Z safety bound triggers a magnitude stop.

bands.corner: actual radial>33 within P33; overlaps high, not part of additive partition

metrics: State/invariants each native step; error only at EXACT saved reference times (101/102 all801, 104 archive297). Uniform paired primary statistics use 81 common .05 times, full excludes t=1; early1.2<=t<=2.2, late2.2<t<=5, endpoint5.
spectra: E,Z and T_K,T_Z for advection, viscosity, forcing, Sd,Sb,SGS,RHS at 81 native states; use already evaluated k1 except final endpoint. Reference transfers use saved reference fields at reference states only.
fresh_bias: At .05 sample a scheduled fresh head is already available as pending. It scores predicted vs fresh on SAME own state but never replaces active pair until second refresh.
reference_Source_accuracy: Only separately reused frozen reference-state CSV when identity verified; history Source vs fresh is model consistency, NOT true SGS accuracy at autonomous w
storage: Immutable endpoint+4 RHS per accepted step; lossless raw-head anchors separately; full-flux snapshots each .05 include predicted/fresh raw heads. Estimated raw plus reconstructed storage ~28GB; actual measured.
resume: Same manual command resumes. Check protocol/code/input SHA and runtime identity. Recover complete step files before replay. Append-only durable invocation journal counts started CNN/RHS even in interrupted work. At most two uncommitted-step replays per trajectory/startup, with fixed extra-call allowance; no silent budget growth.
budget_scope: All actual checkpoint forwards, refresh, endpoint and replay counted. No extra offline CNN or benchmark forwards. Paired speedups use measured complete equal-horizon solver and total wall time, report I/O/diagnostic overhead and shared startup separately; partial failed runs are never a t5 speedup.
scientific_gate: No numeric long-run accuracy/tail gate exists in frozen protocol. Do not invent one. Report per-pair absolute metrics and signs, all failures; classification below is predeclared descriptive, not a convergence/stability theorem.
classification: Any Parameter-PC physical/numerical main failure => STOP current strict candidate. Local timestep physical failure => CONDITIONAL_TIME_DISCRETIZATION_NOT_ROBUST. Otherwise use fixed all-six paired full/t5 MSE signs vs Aug/Hold, K/Z/high-Z bias signs and MEASURED equal-horizon speedup vs Fresh. No new fitted tolerance; retain CONDITIONAL on reference quality even if empirical success.
forbidden: No training, new network/loss, checkpoint selection, weights/period/threshold scan, DNS/reference generation, source kick fallback, extra limiter, Eq, MultiIC weights, or 201/202/301/302 data

timestep_diagnostic.description: Same own state and SAME already-refreshed coarse-step history. Compare saved one h step against two h/2 native RK4 steps. No history refresh between half steps, keep h=.005 as history time unit. Do not select a different h from result.

candidate: Parameter-PC and Parameter-Hold are FULL-head temporal predictors; they do not evaluate current CNN between refreshes. Current C4/gradient/support/limiter always recomputed.
proof_boundary: Per-orientation original decoder and mean qd structure can be proved; final mean qb signed envelope is NOT universally preserved. Runtime strict gate applies. Neither local tests nor t5 experiments prove global accuracy or asymptotic stability.
source_evaluation: Reuse archived reference-state Aug/Fresh errors and distinguish own-state fresh consistency. No future labels in autonomous RHS.
manual_execution_authorization: User 2026-11-16 explicitly retained MANUAL complete rollout; Codex may implement and run CPU synthetic only.
